To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a method to estimate RNA synthesis, degradation and processing rates from a single metabolic labeling experiment and that the rates we obtained correlated well with previously published results.

(a) RNA turnover rate estimation is feasible from a single time point in a metabolic labeling experiment; (b) the method is computationally fast, and outputs rates that are consistent with previously published results; and (c) having sample based estimates of RNA processing and degradation rate enables the use of replicate samples to estimate uncertainties and to perform quality control.

the development of computational methods to study RNA processing, degradation and synthesis rates.
the development of a new method for estimating RNA processing and degradation from single time point RNA sequencing data.
